constraints: sole writer this wave: scripts/mcp_spine_server.py, episodes/**
never hand-edit episodes/** -- only scripts/apply_episode_delta.py --store-root episodes writes it
never fabricate a mechanical field -- skip capture (log why to stderr, never raise) when episode_capture.mechanical_fields() cannot honestly derive all nine MECHANICAL_SCALAR_FIELDS

every agent-supplied field must be a literal derivation from data the refusal itself produced -- never invented narrative (EPISODE_STORE.md section 10 tension, resolved this way per DESIGN_NOTE.md; state this reasoning in the handoff so the crew does not relitigate it)
do not touch scripts/checklist_engine.py (lane H owns it this wave) or docs/EPISODE_STORE.md (lane D1 owns docs/** this wave)
no-inode-containment stands -- do not touch the hardlink hole

capture only the population already reaching _tool_error with both tool and rejection_class set (the same population _log_rejection already writes to mcp_rejections.jsonl) -- never engine-native refusals through run_engine
skip capture entirely when SPINE is None (no bound spine, no work-id to attribute to) -- state this plainly, do not invent a sentinel run id
in-process dedup: capture at most once per (tool, rejection_class) pair per door-process lifetime, to bound a retry-loop

decision: capture-is-literal-derivation-only -- resolves EPISODE_STORE.md sec.10's categorical no-auto-create stance by making every synthesized field a literal quotation/extraction of real refusal data, never invented judgment; a genuine unresolved tension with sec.10's literal text, floated to the Admiral in the run's return rather than treated as settled. @grade: guess · leans g1-implement,g1-review · settle: run the acceptance trigger, show the five fields against the real captured episode, confirm none reads as invented
